svg.title: Give Every Delivery Responsibility an Owner
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-client-delivery-accountability; chapter number: 11; title: Give Every Delivery Responsibility an Owner; subtitle: Coordinate installation, migration, support, and priced scope changes around explicit accountability.; caption: Scott Bartnick assigns onboarding owners; Austin Reed checks production installation; Nate Herk distinguishes migration from credential setup; Automate AI Consulting bounds support; Quiet Client prepares reviewed add-ons.; assumptions note: Scott Bartnick calls for named owners, not a specified staffing count. Austin Reed, Nate Herk, Automate AI Consulting, and Quiet Client describe responsibilities that need not correspond to separate employees.; note: Scott Bartnick — d9zqCrUn7mY at 00:06:07 and 00:08:30; Austin Reed — mw1V2GoYHsk at 00:04:05; Nate Herk | AI Automation — t1PTmpas0bg at 00:03:55 and 00:08:56; Automate AI Consulting — 91lw5ubtLMc at 00:04:45; Quiet Client — csELc0aBrp4 at 00:03:42; The Contractor AI — J5BBjGKyoUE at 00:26:06.; chart type: org_architecture; center: role: Named delivery accountability; headcount: Not specified by the practitioners; focus: Scott Bartnick assigns an owner at each onboarding stage, tracks due dates, and confirms client strategy.; spokes: role: Production installation; type: Delivery responsibility; kpi: Austin Reed checks production credentials and behavior when moving beyond the test environment.; role: Migration reconciliation; type: Migration responsibility; kpi: Nate Herk marks processed items and manually resets credentials; users and executions do not transfer through the demonstrated method.; role: Delivered-work support; type: Support responsibility; kpi: Automate AI Consulting provides 30 days of support on delivered work; ongoing maintenance is a separate commitment.; role: Scope and change approval; type: Commercial responsibility; kpi: Quiet Client leaves missing facts and prices bracketed for review. The Contractor AI collects change orders upfront rather than at final invoicing.
